hunt for a job: After graduating from college, Kevin spent three months trying to hunt for a job in a big city.
大學畢業後，凱文花了三個月試著在大城市找工作。
hunt down a criminal: The police worked day and night to hunt down a criminal who had robbed five banks in one month.
警方日以繼夜地追捕一名在一個月內搶了五家銀行的罪犯。
hunt for bargains: During the holiday sale, my mother walked from shop to shop to hunt for bargains on winter clothes.
假期特賣期間，我媽媽一家店逛過一家店，尋找冬衣的便宜貨。
house hunting: We went house hunting every weekend for two months before we finally found an apartment near the school.
我們每個週末都去找房子，找了兩個月，終於在學校附近找到一間公寓。
witch hunt: The workers felt the boss had started a witch hunt, blaming innocent people for a mistake nobody really made.
員工們覺得老闆發動了一場獵巫行動，把一個其實沒人犯的錯怪罪到無辜的人身上。
hurt one's feelings: Her classmate's rude joke about her weight really hurt her feelings, and she cried after school.
同學拿她的體重開的無禮玩笑真的傷害了她的感情，她放學後哭了。
hurt sales: News of the food safety problem badly hurt sales, and the restaurant lost half of its customers in a week.
食安問題的新聞重創了銷售，那家餐廳一週內就流失了一半的顧客。
hurt one's chances: A single spelling mistake on your résumé may slightly hurt your chances of getting an interview.
履歷上的一個拼字錯誤可能會稍微降低你獲得面試的機會。
it wouldn't hurt to: The sky looks clear now, but it wouldn't hurt to bring an umbrella in case it rains later.
現在天空看起來很晴朗，但不妨帶把傘，以防晚點下雨。
hurt one's pride: Losing the chess game to his little brother hurt his pride, so he refused to play again that night.
下棋輸給弟弟傷了他的自尊，所以那天晚上他拒絕再下。
hush up a scandal: The company paid a lot of money to hush up a scandal, but a reporter still found out the truth.
那家公司花了很多錢掩蓋醜聞，但一位記者還是查出了真相。
hush the baby: On the night train, the young mother sang softly to hush the baby so the other passengers could sleep.
在夜車上，年輕的媽媽輕聲唱歌哄嬰兒安靜，好讓其他乘客能睡覺。
hush money: The politician was accused of paying hush money to a former worker so she would keep the secret.
那位政治人物被指控付封口費給一名前員工，好讓她保守秘密。
a hush fell: When the principal walked onto the stage, a hush fell over the noisy hall and everyone looked up.
當校長走上台時，吵鬧的禮堂全場安靜下來，每個人都抬起頭來。
identify the problem: Before you try to fix the broken computer, you need to identify the problem by checking each part.
在試著修理壞掉的電腦之前，你需要逐一檢查各個零件來找出問題。
identify with a character: Many teenagers identify with a character who feels lonely and misunderstood at a new school.
許多青少年會對一個在新學校感到孤單又被誤解的角色產生共鳴。
identify a suspect: The police asked the shop owner whether she could identify a suspect from the photos on the table.
警方詢問店主她是否能從桌上的照片中指認出嫌犯。
identify the cause: Scientists are still running tests to identify the cause of the strange illness in the village.
科學家們仍在進行檢驗，以查明村子裡那種怪病的原因。
be identified as: Through DNA tests, the man found near the river was identified as the hiker who went missing last week.
透過DNA檢驗，在河邊發現的男子被認定為上週失蹤的登山客。
idle away the afternoon: Instead of studying for the exam, Tom chose to idle away the afternoon playing games on his phone.
湯姆沒有準備考試，反而選擇用手機玩遊戲虛度下午。
the engine idles: Even when the engine idles at a red light, the car still burns fuel and pollutes the air.
即使引擎在紅燈時怠速，車子仍然會燃燒燃料並污染空氣。
workers idled by strikes: Thousands of factory workers idled by strikes had no work and no pay for nearly three weeks.
數千名因罷工而閒置的工廠工人將近三週沒有工作也沒有薪水。
idle talk: Don't believe the idle talk about the new teacher; most of those stories are just made up.
別相信那些關於新老師的閒聊，那些故事大多只是編出來的。
ignite passion: A great science teacher can ignite passion for learning in students who once found the subject boring.
一位優秀的自然老師能點燃那些曾覺得這科無聊的學生對學習的熱情。
ignite a debate: The minister's careless remark about young people ignited a debate that lasted for weeks online.
部長對年輕人的一句輕率言論引發了一場在網路上持續數週的辯論。
ignite protests: Experts warn that any sudden rise in fuel prices could be the spark that will ignite protests across the country.
專家警告，任何油價的突然上漲都可能成為引爆全國抗議的導火線。
ignite the fuel: A single spark can ignite the fuel, so you should never smoke or use a lighter at a gas station.
一個小火花就能點燃燃料，所以你絕對不該在加油站抽菸或使用打火機。
illustrate a point: The speaker told a funny story about his own childhood to illustrate a point about the value of failure.
講者講了一個關於自己童年的有趣故事，來說明他對失敗價值的觀點。
illustrate with examples: Our English teacher likes to illustrate with examples from daily life, so the grammar rules are easy to remember.
我們的英文老師喜歡用日常生活中的例子舉例說明，所以文法規則很容易記住。
illustrate a book: The young artist was hired to illustrate a book of fairy tales, and she drew over fifty colorful pictures.
那位年輕畫家受聘為一本童話書畫插圖，她畫了五十多幅色彩繽紛的圖。
illustrate the difficulty: The long lines at the clinic illustrate the difficulty that people in rural areas face in seeing a doctor.
診所前的大排長龍顯示了偏鄉居民看醫生所面臨的困難。
